name: sidebar-notes
description: The AI notetaker that never joins the call. Records and summarizes meetings from the background.
author: Harris Partners

scripts.check: node --check src/main/main.js && node --check src/main/store.js && node --check src/main/transcribe.js && node --check src/main/summarize.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/renderer/app.js && node --check src/renderer/recorder.js

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sidebar records your microphone so your side of the conversation is in the notes.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Sidebar records your computer's audio so the other people on your call are in the notes.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: macOS uses this permission to let Sidebar record your computer's audio. Sidebar never records your screen.
